subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The most effective way to enhance your vocabulary is to__ look to__ unknown words in a dictionary.
solution:
The correct answer is: **look up**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"look up"** means to search for information in a reference book, on the internet, etc. (खोजना)

 
 
• **Example: **You can look up the meaning of words in a dictionary.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **look up**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **write off** (लिख देना): To cancel a debt; to accept that an amount of money has been lost.

 
 
• **Example:** The company had to write off several bad debts.
 
 
 
• **set by** (सहेजना): To save something for future use.
 
 
• **Example: **She sets by a portion of her salary every month for emergencies.
 
 
 
• **stand against** (विरोध करना): To oppose or resist.
 
 
• **Example:** They stood against the new policy changes.
